'''Po Bandis''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who, in addition to being a member of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], served as a [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] of the [[313th Legion]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy-spanning]] conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].

==Biography==
Po Bandis was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. After years of study and work with the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]], Bandis would pass the [[Jedi Trials/Legends|Trials of Knighthood]] to reach the rank of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] and finally made a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]].<ref name="TLL" />

When the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] erupted between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], Master Bandis dutifully took up the rank of [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] within the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. Leading [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] against the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]], Bandis was placed in command of the [[313th Legion]] and tasked with locating a Separatist base located on [[Ando Prime/Legends|Ando Prime]]. Discovering a massive droid production facility, Bandis led his troops to destroy it but were intercepted by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Terrus]] and his droid army. As they did battle, the [[Skakoan/Legends|Skakoan]] engineer [[Vylagos]] activated his experimental [[Wormhole/Legends|hyperspace wormhole]] transporter, which transported Bandis and his men off-planet to an unknown location in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="TLL" />

Detecting Bandis's disappearance, the High Council dispatched Jedi Master [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] to locate the Jedi and his clones. Leading [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Vargus]] and [[Excelsior Company]] to Ando Prime, the Jedi encounter a medic, [[Gen-Goma/Legends|Gen-Goma]], who helped them extract information from Vylagos about the experimental machine. Reactivating the machine, the Skakoan brought back Bandis and his troops, who then aided in shutting down the Separatist base.<ref name="TLL" />
